Delivery database.

div.div:
Processing rule: atomically record consumer receipt + notification / webhook job, then commit Kafka offset. Worker attempts are persisted.
Exhausted retries -> failed job / DLQ review. Signed webhooks carry eventId + state version; receiver deduplicates.
Optional WEBHOOK_ATTEMPTS child table (delivery_id FK) stores attempt timestamps / outcome; no full sensitive response bodies.
